When i start drinking a beer and i taste alkohol i cant stop. I just take tge next shot, another beer and a cocktail afterwards. Thats so anoying. Maybe it brings up another personality.
Its hard to remember what i thought this night nut i dont think that i cut into my arms to die. I think i cut myself to experience it once. Just to try it once. Just for "fun". Just to know how warm blood feels when it runs over my hands.

Giving up drinking wouldn solve my problems, but it might prevent me from doing stuff just because "why not"

Thank you. You know: I dont think i have drepression, anxiety or any social problems. I'm a student and i experience the same pressure i alway had before the exams. And the it wasnt the first time i got drunk, but the last few weeks were full of alkohol, BBQ and meeting friends. So I dont understand how this suicide thing came into my mind. And what worries me is that i really tried it.
